timeline.fact: Morgul the Road-Wolf, covets the deep roads, rises for Ashen Marauders Camp.
Morgul the Road-Wolf advances along the frontier roads toward the hold.
Morgul the Road-Wolf demands tribute and submission from the council.
Morgul the Road-Wolf breaches the outer works; structures and territory are contested.
Morgul the Road-Wolf meets Urdrak Trueward <dwarf_12> in the decisive battle.
Urdrak Trueward <dwarf_12> turns back Morgul the Road-Wolf through champion.
Morgul the Road-Wolf retreats from the hold after champion.
The hold enters recovery after Morgul the Road-Wolf's siege (colony_victory).
